Target POC start: 2026-11-15

1) Confirm SRE and identity owners for the items above.
2) Share VPC CIDR / peering contact and preferred maintenance window for peering (we recommended after-hours to minimize risk).
3) Provide a test user for SAML handshake and a KMS key ARN or confirm we can use a customer-managed key.

Nikhil, copying you to add technical detail and sample artifacts.

Thanks — I can block a 30-min sync early next week if helpful.

Thanks Ben — adding a few technical notes and quick steps so your team can hand this to SRE/identity: 

1) Egress IPs: authoritative list in network-reqs.xlsx (tab "egress_ips"): 54.172.21.8, 54.172.21.9, 54.172.21.10 (these are NAT egress ranges for the Redwood POC pool). If you need CIDR blocks instead we can provide aggregated ranges by EOD.

2) VPC peering: we request the peer accepter (Acme) create a VPC peering connection from your side and share the peering ID. Redwood will accept and configure route table entries on our managed side. Steps are in the attachment. Preferred maintenance window: weekday 02:00-04:00 local.

3) SAML / SSO: attached is redwood-saml-sample.xml — it'll include our ACS and SP metadata. The handshake items we need from Acme: IdP metadata XML, test user in your IdP, and an account-level attribute mapping for email + groups. After you share IdP metadata we can perform a test within 24 hours.

4) KMS / secrets: For the POC we support either Redwood-managed keys (quicker) or a customer-managed KMS key. If you opt for customer-managed, please provide the KMS key ARN and add the Redwood service principal (redwood-kms@redwood-inference.iam) with Encrypt/Decrypt permissions. We can provide a minimal IAM policy sample.

Action items (owner / due):
- Share VPC CIDR + create peering request (Ben) / due 2026-11-03
- Share IdP metadata + test user (Kamal) / due 2026-11-08
- Confirm KMS approach + provide ARN (Samira) / due 2026-11-08

Happy to pair with your SRE/identity team — I can do 30-min pairing sessions Tue/Wed afternoons PST next week.

— Nikhil
